subject: Setting the seed in bootstrapLavaan for reproducible results

messages.author: 6f81c58ba9ed02c3
messages.subject: Setting the seed in bootstrapLavaan for reproducible results
parts:
Hello lavaan community,

I am having an issue with being able to get reproducible results for a 95% confidence interval by setting the seed in the bootstrapLavaan function. This is the code I am using:

RNGkind("L'Ecuyer-CMRG")
bootout.m6 <- bootstrapLavaan(miss.m6.fit.wgt, R = 100, type = "nonparametric", FUN = lavInspect, what = "theta", iseed = 1234)
apply(bootout.m6, 2, quantile, probs = c(.025, .975))

Every time I run this analysis, I get different lower and upper values for my confidence interval, but it is my understanding that by setting the seed via "iseed," I should be able to reproduce the same results whenever I run this analysis.

Best,

Ryan

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Setting the seed in bootstrapLavaan for reproducible results
parts: Every time I run this analysis, I get different lower and upper values for my confidence interval, but it is my understanding that by setting the seed via "iseed," I should be able to reproduce the same results whenever I run this analysis.

That argument is passed to the parallel package functions that are trigged by selecting parallel = "snow" (in Windows, Mac, or Linux) or parallel = "multicore" (in Mac or Linux).  If you don't use parallel processing, then just set the seed normally using set.seed()
